description:
This is a maximum level strider build. Buckle up. Strap that car seat down…these specs are fantastical.

Paul…everything. Hubs. New short reach lever dialed in a bit for tiny hands. A Klamper. Yes…the worlds finest mechanical disc brake. And for the sharp eye…you can see we upgraded to the raw brass barrel adjuster.

King headset. Chris King.

Blacksheep titanium seatpost

An oddmonē collab bar in turbo midnight.

New Monē Lightweight Brazed stem.

all our raw brass machine parts. spoke nipples. Seat clamp. bar plugs. top cap

a unique 14” strider build with legit knobby tires…we’re calling it the 29er of striders.

Is this way over the top?…depends on how you define “top”. Does it make sense? Do any of our bikes “make sense?” I can tell you this is a very nice strider bike that might bring as much joy to you and your kiddo.
